capabilities: Suggest tags and links for the active note or a whole folder via AI
Merge duplicate and cross-language tags into a canonical tag
Scan the vault for broken links, empty notes, orphans, duplicates, and untagged notes
Redact or exclude private content before it is sent to the AI provider
Log every applied change and restore deleted, archived, or merged states
extras: DeepSeek support was removed in v1.0.2 because it lacks an embedding API; embedding-based features (tag similarity, link suggestions) degrade without a provider that supports embeddings. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. All AI calls consume tokens and the plugin displays per-call cost estimates.
motivation: The README frames the goal as "Focus on writing. Let AI handle the organization."
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically tag, link, and clean up notes at scale, so users must organize large vaults manually.

relations.evidence: Select your provider (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Ollama, or Custom) and enter your API key

requires.name: OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Custom provider API key

summary: AI-powered vault maintenance plugin that suggests tags and links, merges duplicate tags, and scans for broken links, orphans, and duplicates.
